page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 8 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, paired with 31.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 3.88 GB per core. The instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, providing 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance trade-off. The host CPU and memory subsystem exhibit relatively low performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU metrics falling into the bottom 25% tier, and Geekbench single-core scores categorized in the bottom 10%. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong acceleration for specific workloads. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier performance for prompt processing with both small (135M) and medium (7B) models, reaching 8407.18 and 1134.43 tokens per second respectively, alongside strong text generation speeds for medium models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a budget-friendly entry point into GPU-accelerated computing by pairing a modest, older-generation Intel Xeon CPU with a dedicated enterprise GPU. It is poorly suited for CPU-heavy tasks, database operations, or high-throughput web serving, as reflected in its weak Redis and static web serving benchmarks. Instead, the instance is optimized for lightweight machine learning inference, small-to-medium LLM deployment, and GPU-assisted rendering or video transcoding where CPU performance is not the primary bottleneck.
